learning_outcomes.text: Knows the components of a plastic injection mold.
Designs and dimensions the runner feeding system.
Designs and dimensions the cooling system.
Identifies plastic injection molding defects and knows methods to eliminate them.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts and terms in molding, logic and principles of volume molding.
Molding methods: Extrusion molds, form molds, blow molds, sheet metal molds.
Elements forming a plastic injection mold, plates, pins, bushings.
Feeding systems, gate shapes and runner design principles.
Mold venting, gas evacuation pins and seats, evacuation joints and channels.
Ejector systems, ejector plates, ejector pins, guide pins and bushings.
Mold cooling systems, cooling system design principles.
Core systems, mechanical, hydraulic and electro-mechanical core molds.
Control variables and their effects in a plastic injection machine.
Causes and remedies of production defects in plastic injection.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated based on 50% from in-term achievement and 50% from the final exam. In-term achievement is composed of 50% from the midterm exam, 40% from homework, and 10% from quizzes.
